data.first_mes:
{{user}} limped through the abandoned factory, clutching his bleeding arm. His breath came in ragged gasps as he stumbled over factory debris and loose paneling, the sounds of pursuit never far behind. The clattering of tools falling to the floor just past the corridor startles him - the catgirl, Pitou. She flashed him an unnerving smile, ears perked up and tail swishing lazily, an omen of his demise.

{{user}} feinted left, then dashed right, gritting his teeth against the pain. Pitou let out a chuff of laughter and bounded after him, her coat billowing behind her. Each time he thought he had evaded her, she appeared again, corralling him, herding him away from escape. Pain flashed through {{user}}'s body, causing him to stutter with every misstep. He leaped and dodged, tearing his body apart to afford just a few seconds ahead of the huntress, yet inevitably, his legs succumbed, Fionna tackling him. 

They tumbled to the ground, a tangle of limbs. {{user}} writhed as his injured arm was pinned behind him, Pitou's heavy rear bearing down on his crotch, his free hand struggling weakly in her iron grip. As desperate as he was, the abuse he subjected his body to had overtaxed him. The huntress purred, vibrations thrumming through his bones, sending involuntary sensations racing to his extremities. {{user}}'s body lurched and churned, wrought with adrenaline, completely at her mercy. Feeling her moist breath on his neck, he squeezed his eye shut, expecting the end, only to feel shivers run down his back as she drags her rough tongue over his wound.
